title: JAFZA Activity List for Businesses: What You Need to Know
description: Explore the JAFZA Activity List and learn how to choose the right business license in Dubai’s top free zone for global growth.

contentHtml:
JAFZA contributes nearly 23.9% of Dubai’s GDP and hosts more than 9,000 companies from over 140 countries. That makes it one of the strongest free zones in the world. But for many entrepreneurs, the biggest hurdle isn’t location or infrastructure, it’s understanding what activities they can legally operate.

Pick the wrong category, and you risk delays, higher costs, or even restrictions on your growth. The solution? A clear understanding of the JAFZA Activity List, which outlines approved business operations in the free zone.

This guide covers everything you need to know about this topic: 

  • Discover what JAFZA
  • Explore the full JAFZA Business Activity List
  • Learn how to apply for or modify your activities step by step. 

Whether you’re launching a startup or scaling globally, this blog helps you choose the right activities and avoid costly mistakes from the start.

What is JAFZA?

You know what freezone is, right? A self-governing economic area, which is many in the UAE. Among them, Jebel Ali Free Zone Authority JAFZA is one of the most recognized free zones in the UAE. It is located near the world-class Jebel Ali Port and Al Maktoum International Airport. Serving as a hub for trade, manufacturing, and services, it attracts thousands of businesses globally.

You benefit from world-class infrastructure if you choose to set up your business here. Also, you get the flexibility of choosing from a wide business licenses in Dubai portfolio tailored to your needs.

Key Advantages of Business Setup in JAFZA

  • 100% foreign ownership and profit repatriation
  • World-class logistics and transport facilities
  • A diverse range of office spaces, warehouses, and land plots
  • Tax-free environment for businesses
  • Easy access to international markets

What is the JAFZA Activity List?

Business activities are streamlined in this zone, but come with limitations and specific rules. The JAFZA Activity List defines the categories of business operations companies can undertake within the free zone. It ensures that businesses operate legally while enjoying tailored benefits. From industrial projects to logistics, and services to trading, JAFZA provides a structured framework for companies to align their operations with approved categories.

Having clarity on this list helps investors choose activities that match their goals and avoid future compliance issues. For reference, the JAFZA Free Zone Activity List is updated regularly to meet evolving industry demands.

JAFZA Business Activities List

This economic freezone offers a broad spectrum of business activities, enabling entrepreneurs to select options that best fit their vision. Investors can explore the JAFZA Business Activity List to understand which sector aligns with their goals.

Industrial/Manufacturing Activities

These activities include assembling, processing, and producing goods. Companies in JAFZA can access modern industrial units and infrastructure designed for large-scale production.

This includes all food and beverage manufacturing, Electronics assembly, Chemical production, and Textile and garment manufacturing.

Trading Activities

Trading remains one of JAFZA’s strongest pillars. Investors can import, export, distribute, and store a wide variety of goods under the JAFZA License Activities List.

Examples:

  • Import and export of consumer goods
  • Wholesale distribution
  • Storage and re-export of items

Service Activities

This category is designed for businesses offering specialized skills or consultancy services. JAFZA recognizes the growing demand for knowledge-based industries.

Examples:

  • IT consultancy
  • Legal services
  • Marketing and advertising agencies
  • Business management consultancy

Transportation & Logistics

Given JAFZA’s strategic location, logistics plays a crucial role in supporting international trade. Businesses benefit from proximity to Jebel Ali Port and airports.

Examples:

  • Freight forwarding
  • Shipping and cargo handling
  • Warehousing and distribution services

Specialized Activities

There are such few industries that require unique licenses to cater to niche markets. JAFZA provides these options under specialized activities.

Examples:

  • Healthcare services
  • Education and training centers
  • Renewable energy projects

Key Industry Sectors in JAFZA

This free zone supports some major industries and provides a safe environment to grow. This not only contributes to Dubai’s economy but also fuels its successful future. Those sectors are

  • Automotive
  • Petrochemicals
  • Consumer electronics
  • E-commerce
  • Food and beverages

This wide JAFZA List of Activities helps entrepreneurs across industries find suitable options for sustainable business growth.

How to Apply for a Business Activity in JAFZA

The process to apply for business activity in JAFZA an never been easier than this. This step-by-step approach provides a clear guideline for you to follow. The process ensures that your company operates under approved license activities aligned with JAFZA regulations.

  • Understand your Business Activity Needs

First, decide on the type of activity you want to pursue. Consider whether your business will involve trading, services, or industrial operations.

  • Prepare your Documents

Gather the required paperwork, such as passport copies, application forms, and business plans. This ensures a smooth approval process.

  • Submit Initial Application

Submit your initial request to JAFZA with the selected activity type. This stage includes paying initial fees.

  • Receive Preliminary Approval

Once JAFZA reviews your application, you will get initial approval. This allows you to move forward with office or warehouse selection.

  • Sign the Lease Agreement

Choose your preferred facility, office space, warehouse, or land plot. Sign the lease agreement with JAFZA.

  • Finalise Licensing & Registration

After signing the lease, proceed to finalize company registration and licensing. You will receive your JAFZA trade license upon approval.

  • 7.Apply for Visas & Other Services

Lastly, apply for employee visas, residency permits, and additional services that support your business operations in JAFZA.

By following these steps, you can easily align with the JAFZA Free Zone Activity List while ensuring compliance.

How to Add or Modify Business Activities in JAFZA?

As your business expands, you may need to add new services or shift into other industries. JAFZA offers a simple process for updating your activities. To start, prepare the required documents such as your trade license, application form, and business plan. Submit them to JAFZA along with the applicable modification fee. Once reviewed, the authority will approve, ensuring your license matches your updated operations. This flexibility allows you to adjust without disrupting daily business. Many companies revisit the JAFZA License Activities List to explore new opportunities and stay competitive in Dubai’s dynamic free zone market.

FAQs

Is it possible to include multiple business activities in JAFZA?

Yes, it is. You can include more than one activity. However, make sure if they align with the license type.

How to select the appropriate activity for your business?

Select based on your core operations, long-term goals, and JAFZA’s approved activity list.

Who Approves Business Activities in JAFZA?

The Jebel Ali Free Zone Authority reviews and approves all proposed business activities across the UAE.

Conclusion

Choosing JAFZA for your business setup opens the door to global market access. The tax-free benefits and the flexibility to choose from a wide range of activities are the cherry on top. From trading to logistics and services, the JAFZA Activity List supports every industry. 

Secure your future in Dubai’s most dynamic free zone and enjoy unmatched growth opportunities. Ready to begin? Take the first step today and establish your business confidently in JAFZA.
